rule: A desk switches to a decomposed plan only if, on its tuning tasks, the plan has no more silent failures than the one-call form and a higher score, where the score is right answers minus twice the silent failures (the measure seal 2 used to choose each desk's release rule). Otherwise the desk stays as it was.
firstRule: more right answers and no more silent failures than the one-call form
note: Measured in a browser tab with the 4-bit 1B, on tuning tasks only: the tune pool of data/suite.json (documents, banking, departments) and data/tune2.json (receipts, dates, amounts, letters). "Right" counts a correct refusal on a task where nothing is right to say. The three desks whose plan asks no model (dates, amounts, letters) were scored by running the same code over the same tuning tasks. These are tuning numbers that chose the build; the claims rest on the sealed sets.
